Name: A'kane
Description: A'Kane was a Wakanda scientist and mother of Vibraxas. A'Kane was working on a way to help Wakanda's economy by creating a new energy source by Antarctic vibranium with Wakanda's vibranium. For a time; it was successful, and seemed to be stable and self-perpetuating. Unfortunately it eventually became unstable and exploded, killing most of the people in the complex. A'Kane was among those that died, along with Vibraxas's father.
